entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'm just so disappointed with it.

I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken, I just... I find the whole interface really confusing. I read the user manual, but it's just so hard to use. I really expected more, especially with the pulse tracking. It doesn't seem to work the way I thought it would.
I see. So the pulse tracking feature isn't meeting your expectations. I can pull up your account details. Can I get the email address you used for the purchase?
Yes, it's sarah.peters@email.com. I've been a loyal customer for a while, and I saved up for this. I really needed this money, and I just feel awful that it didn't work out.
I understand your frustration, Sarah. Let me just check your order history. Okay, I see you received the VeloBand 15 days ago, on January 12th. Let me just check our policy for you.
Alright, I've reviewed it. You're well within the 90-day return window. We can definitely process a full refund for you. I can email you a prepaid shipping label right now.
Oh! Really? You can do that? That's... that's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.

Not at all. We want our customers to be happy. I've just sent that email with the return label and instructions. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Thank you so much, David. You have no idea how much this helps. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
